headline: Airbnb has added AI search, AI comparisons of saved homes and more services to its redesigned app.
score_reason: Confirmed company update, described by one outlet; useful but incremental.
importance_line: Travellers can search in plain language and compare listings side by side, and more booking-day services are coming, though some services start only in November or in select cities.
summary: TechRadar reports that Airbnb is adding natural-language AI search, typed or spoken, across homes, experiences and services to its redesigned app, along with AI that suggests filters, highlights listing features and compares saved properties side by side. Airbnb is also widening AI customer support chat to more than 50 languages, with phone voice support to follow, and adding services such as baby gear rental from November in more than 60 US cities and laundry pickup in select US cities.
